status: Production native journal and actual tool-host adapters implemented; focused independent tests passed, including host rerun after shell integration. Root aggregate/UI verification is separate.
preservedReference: reference/native-experiments/file-mutations (original bytes unchanged; prototype is not the production authority)

contracts.implemented: Mounted bounded UTF-8 content, source fence stripping for model write; exact raw sandbox write; missing parents created with tracked ownership; missing and empty kept distinct; durable preimage precedes mutation.
Sequential nonoverlapping replacements, unmatched items skipped, count reported, UTF-8 growth checked before allocation; complete transaction rollback on failure. Empty search is rejected explicitly.

Explicit move boolean; file into directory uses basename; recursive directory merge preserves unrelated children; changed destination and moved source states captured before changes; binary content exact.
Files and bounded recursive trees; captured child names never authorize deleting later foreign entries; same-identity empty directory removal only; rollback restores owned files/topology.

User host API selects mutation IDs, merges earliest before/latest after for selected chains, validates current identity+bytes and original physical root; conflicting user edits preserved. Undo itself is durable history.

architecture.journal: SQLite WAL with synchronous FULL; content-addressed before/after snapshots and file/directory intent states; unique host nonce distinct from reused model toolCallId.
architecture.ownership: Per-agent owner lock covers apply, recovery, undo and deletion. Per-agent shared lease revokes asynchronous executors. Profile storage and opened ancestor directories pinned on Windows.
architecture.publication: Prepared journal before filesystem changes; staged files and retained backups use nonreplace rename, identity checks and explicit rollback/recovery states. Filesystem-wide atomicity is not claimed.
architecture.async: ToolExecutor value-only callback runs on QtConcurrent; generation/request checks suppress stale completion. AgentToolHost serializes undo/recovery and emits confirmed fileChanged for editors.
architecture.rawSandbox: SandboxHost requestOwnerId maps host RPC back to active opaque request, then AgentEngine externalToolCallId supplies model provenance; page/JS arguments cannot choose another chat or original call ID.
architecture.forkAndDelete: Fork observes current files but starts separate undo authority; copying message metadata does not authorize source edits. Cleanup deletes only its journal/snapshots and preserves workspace files; unresolved recovery blocks cleanup.
architecture.executorCompatibility: Original three-argument ToolExecutor::execute slot remains available for existing Qt signal connections; executeWithProvenance carries the explicit host-only mutation provenance.

publicHostApi.historyRowRecovery: recoveryRequired boolean includes unfinished committed cleanup; UI must not hide it merely because state is committed.

focusedVerification.scope: Exact bytes and empty/missing, sequential edit growth, copy/move/delete and recursive topology, grouped undo, conflicts, reparse/root replacement, pinned ancestors, lock interleaving, process-exit apply and rollback recovery, cancellation/revocation, separate agents, partial owned staging, late foreign child and hard bounds.

All four provider protocols through local HTTP fixtures; write/edit/copy/delete persisted metadata and grouped undo; restart/fork/user-edit protection; raw binary/fence write and original sandbox call attribution; queued cancellation; host destruction during undo fileChanged; one undo/recovery host lane.

reproducedFixes.defect: Rollback after directory creation tried to reopen parents for a staged file never reached by apply.
reproducedFixes.fix: Missing planned parents permitted while loading/recovering; absent unreached staging cleanup skipped after identity validation.

reproducedFixes.defect: Revocation interrupted durable rollback after restoring a deleted directory.
reproducedFixes.fix: Lease revocation stops apply but does not inject failure into rollback boundaries.

reproducedFixes.defect: Second different host undo/recovery request could enter while another was pending.
reproducedFixes.fix: Reject all new undo/recovery requests until the host lane settles.

reproducedFixes.defect: Committed changes still requiring backup cleanup were not visible as recovery work in host history.
reproducedFixes.fix: Every history row now exposes recoveryRequired, including committed+cleaned=false; recovery clears flag without reverting committed bytes.

build.sharedBuild: No shared build used for these counts; root owns aggregate integration.

remainingGaps: Full Stagewise parity is not achieved. Native history has exact byte snapshots and UI summary/undo. Root added bounded UI-only metadata.fileDiff rendering; model output _diff remains null and complete upstream diff-summary/import compatibility is not claimed.
Raw sandbox fs rename/copyFile/rm/unlink remain unsupported; model copy(move)/delete are implemented. mkdir retains existing native no-history behavior.
Every actual AgentToolHost installs the durable callback. Unconfigured standalone ToolExecutor write/multiEdit retains legacy atomic-write fallback and is not claimed durable.

Only local Windows drive scopes are supported; UNC, device/ADS paths, reparse points, hardlinks and mount-root mutation are rejected. Simultaneous workspace mounts and plans/logs support remain separate gaps.
ACLs, alternate streams and all original filesystem metadata are not preserved; exact file bytes and tracked directory topology are the tested contract.
A process can exit between CREATE_NEW/CreateDirectory and persistence of its new file identity. Recovery fails closed on unrecognized reserved entries rather than deleting guessed ownership.
Process termination fixtures verify selected application crash boundaries. They do not establish universal power-loss durability or filesystem-wide atomic visibility.
Journal capacity rejects new operations before mutation rather than silently dropping undo history; no pruning or original Stagewise SQLite migration is implemented.
External editors can modify in-mount content between separate operations; native physical identity/content checks detect conflicts rather than granting authority from historical paths.
